dials.label: Drama
positions: A sweet, cozy story where the worst thing that happens is a burnt dinner
Mostly warm, with a few hurt feelings to work through
Ups and downs: real arguments, real makeups
Messy: secrets, grudges, and at least one big blowup
Reality-TV chaos: betrayals, feuds, and someone storming out of every party

dials.label: Predictability
positions: You're in control: the plan lays everything out, no surprises
Mostly planned, with one small surprise tucked in
A clear direction, plus a twist waiting to happen
Expect the unexpected: a twist that could change where the story goes
Surprise me: a twist that could flip everything you thought you knew

dials.label: Relationship planning
positions: Leave love wide open: no pairings planned, let your Sims decide
Hint at a spark or two, but nothing's decided
Some chemistry set up, and room for it to go either way
Clear crushes and tensions: you'll know who's drawn to whom
Fully set up: who's into whom, who's in the way, and why

dials.label: Pace
positions: Slow burn: plenty of quiet days before anything big happens
Steady: small changes that build over weeks
Balanced: something meaningful happens most sim-weeks
Brisk: big moments come quickly
Fast: something big happens on day one

supernatural.label: Add supernatural elements
supernatural.on: Vampires, spellcasters, ghosts, or aliens from your packs can show up in the story.
supernatural.off: The story stays human, even if you picked a supernatural pack.
supernatural.locked: Pick a pack with supernatural content (Vampires, Realm of Magic, Paranormal Stuff, or Get to Work) to turn this on.
